digest.component_or_area: .github/workflows CI push triggering and branch filters
propositions: Four workflows with on.push triggers must exclude the tickets branch from triggering CI by adding tickets to their branches-ignore lists
A new enumerating test must verify at runtime that all workflow files in .github/workflows/ do not match push events to the tickets branch
Documentation must warn adopters that auto-push-on-write of a tickets branch can trigger CI workflows if misconfigured, with guidance to use schedules instead

The tickets branch is an orphan with no .github/ directory, making it structurally incapable of triggering workflows regardless of branch filters, so the change is a declarative guard for future safety
All schedule cron expressions in edited workflows must remain byte-identical after the change
Push CI for ordinary topic branches must continue to fire after tickets is added to branch filters
